5: I would say that a mere bordermark: [That this] is what the mishnah is discussing. As it too is called a partition. And that which it taught, "who wished," is about the splitting; and it is when it is not subject to the law of division - it teaches us [it must be] a wall; and that which it taught, "who wished," is about the wall. As if they did not want [to split it with a wall], let them split it with a bordermark.
